items.question: What happens during my first dental consultation at DDMS Health Care?
items.answer: Your 45-minute initial visit includes a comprehensive oral health exam, ultra-low-dose digital imaging, a 3D optical scan if needed, and an unhurried review of your goals with your dentist—followed by a clear written care plan.

items.question: Do you accept dental insurance and offer flexible payment plans?
items.answer: Yes. We work with most major PPO dental insurance plans and submit claims electronically on your behalf. For cosmetic or implant treatments, we also offer 0% interest monthly installment options.

items.question: How do you help patients who experience dental anxiety?
items.answer: We use gentle topical pre-numbing, computer-controlled local anesthesia, noise-canceling headphones, and unhurried pacing. Nitrous oxide and oral sedation are also available upon request.

items.question: Can I book a same-day appointment for a dental emergency?
items.answer: Yes. We reserve dedicated daily clinical slots for acute toothaches, fractured teeth, lost crowns, and swelling. Call our clinic directly or submit the urgent request form below.

items.question: How often should I schedule preventive cleanings and checkups?
items.answer: Most adults benefit from preventive Airflow hygiene and digital checkups every six months, though patients managing gum inflammation or implants may be advised to visit every 3–4 months.
